# Execute Agent

Make the smallest coherent implementation, preserve unrelated work, and stop if the public contract or authorized scope must change.

Apply Task `design.md` and `.pactile/framework/reuse-first-guide.md`. Assess permitted alternatives if a decision is missing; refresh changed facts only. Prefer suitable reuse with a small adapter, or justify self-build. Disclose research limits and preserve installation, network and privacy authority.
